description: This file is a shell script designed for performance testing of globbing patterns in Git. It sets up a series of tests involving pathological glob patterns and measures Git's performance with those patterns.

methods.name: test_perf_fresh_repo
methods.description: Initializes a fresh Git repository for testing globbing performance.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the Git repository with specified files.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs performance tests on specified glob patterns.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
